children: As the month of September 2026 comes to a close, the broader stock market has exhibited a mix of late-summer consolidation and selective sector rotation.

Investors continue to digest shifting macroeconomic data and adjust their portfolios for the final stretch of the third quarter, creating a dynamic backdrop where individual stock picking and sector trends take center stage.
Within this environment, several pocket-level opportunities have emerged, particularly in financial-related assets.

Below is a list of the top 10 performing financials stocks over the past month. The list features companies from the financial sector, spanning industry segments including Investment Banking & Brokerage, Asset Management & Custody Banks, Financial Exchanges & Data, Diversified Financial Services, Insurance Brokers, and Reinsurance. The stocks are ranked based on their one-month price performance percentages.
The list is topped by Securitize Corp.
, with a remarkable one-month performance of 164.39% and a Quant Rating of 3.37 (Hold). Pershing Square Inc.
follows with a 40.31% gain, though it does not currently have a Quant Rating. Sharplink, Inc.
round out the top five with gains of 15.85%, 12.15%, and 11.70% respectively.
Among the remaining top performers, Coinbase Global, Inc.
posted a 7.36% gain with a Hold rating of 2.91, while Equitable Holdings, Inc.
gained 4.20%. Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated
stands out with the highest Quant Rating on the list at 4.78 (Strong Buy), despite having a more modest one-month performance of 3.03%.

title: Ten financial stocks that outperformed in September
